errors.error_description: Used a deeply nested chain of ternary operators for the multiplexer selection on a single line, creating a long combinational path instead of using a cleaner case structure.
Instantiated a submodule with a port width mismatch by connecting an 8-bit signal to a 4-bit input port using named association.
Declared a signal that is never used anywhere in the design, leaving dead code.
Assigned an 8-bit bus directly to a 4-bit register, causing silent truncation.
